## Page 25

USA Capacity revenue drove higher core profit
Remark: Core profit equals to net profit minus FX gain/loss and one-time items
*Net profit attributable to owners of parent Core profit & Net profit
In 3Q25, core profit grew by 57.4% YoY and increase by 442.7% QoQ respectively,
due to the increase in share of profit recognition from increased capacity revenue
rate of CCGTs in the USA, improved operating performance from the tank terminal
and seaport businesses, hydropower plants in the Lao PDR and lower interest
expenses.
In9M25, the incline was due to higher performance CCGTs in the USA, wind power 
plants in Thailand, the tank terminal and seaport projects, hydropower plants in the 
Lao PDR, and lower interest expenses. 
In 3Q25, net profit increased YoY and QoQ due to one-time loss of THB 85.6 
million was lower, compared to 3Q24 and 2Q25, that recorded the total one-
time loss of THB 481 million and total one-time loss of THB 782.5 million 
respectively.
In 9M25, net profit declined YoY, primarily due to the recognition of total one-
time loss of THB 913.3 million, compared to 9M24 that recorded a total one-
time gain of THB 760.6 million.
